title: hordeum vulgare subsp. deficiens
intro: Hordeum vulgare subsp. deficiens, commonly known as spelt, is an ancient subspecies of wheat that has been used for centuries for its nutritional and medicinal properties. Spelt is rich in dietary fiber, vitamins, and minerals, providing various health benefits such as improved digestion, reduced inflammation, and enhanced immune function. The plant has therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating conditions like arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of spelt include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phytic acid, which contribute to its medicinal and nutritional value.
